author: /root
purpose: Independent exact-source operational review of a distinct read-only pinned-Git handoff reader; not product finding, application test, cleanup authority or runtime admission
accepted_narrow_controls: Fixed commit/tree, fixed /usr/bin/git plumbing, clean explicit child environment, no replace objects, no application/helper imports or archive extraction.
Package/tree membership, Git object SHA1 header+payload check, package/index SHA256 checks, descriptor validation and preserved same-hash alias consistency.
XZ32MiB decoder and72MiB expanded-TAR bounds, ordinary normalized USTAR-only members, bounded member length, exact digest/membership/padding/EOF checks.
Timeout cancellation targets only the direct unreaped Popen child, never process names or unrelated process groups.
Correct explicit committed-transport-only result, zero application tests and checkout_verification=false.

required_corrections.issue: TimeoutExpired is handled but other interruption/error paths are not. SIGTERM can terminate Python while its direct Git child continues; KeyboardInterrupt or a pipe/error path can leave unverified settlement. Popen context management alone does not establish cancellation cleanup.
required_corrections.counterexample: During child.communicate(), deliver SIGTERM to only the reader PID; default termination bypasses code and Popen finalization. No executed signal is alleged.
required_corrections.required: Install bounded INT/TERM handling before child creation and unconditional positively-owned direct-child stop/reap in a finally path on interruption/error. Distinguish incomplete/failed cleanup and preserve nonzero outcome; document SIGKILL/power loss/uninterruptible kernel limits rather than promising universal settlement.

required_corrections.issue: communicate() accumulates both pipes before len(output)/len(error) checks. The advertised Git output caps are post-hoc, not memory-retention bounds.
required_corrections.counterexample: A trusted plumbing process with an unexpectedly large listing/output or repeated diagnostic can exceed the cap before the check. Pinned object identities constrain ordinary valid payloads but are not a preemptive collector cap.
required_corrections.required: Drain stdout/stderr with incremental per-stream byte bounds and a monotonic deadline; on overflow stop/reap only the owned child. Retain modest bounded diagnostics. Keep implementation narrow rather than importing an archived runner.

required_corrections.issue: UTF8 decoding alone accepts NUL and terminal control bytes; the supplied reader rejected NUL and neutralized non-text controls.
required_corrections.counterexample: An included binary-like UTF8 payload with NUL or text with ESC bytes is emitted verbatim; this weakens display safety relative to the reviewed supplied reader.
required_corrections.required: Refuse NUL/binary-like selected output and neutralize non-text terminal control/format characters while allowing ordinary newline/tab, without changing stored bytes/hash identity.

required_corrections.issue: The duplicate predicate tests the full prefixed path against a map whose keys are prefix-stripped, so it does not reject repeated listing paths.
required_corrections.counterexample: Two listing rows with the same docs/audit-handoff/x path overwrite the x entry; current pinned tree is not alleged to contain such a duplicate.
required_corrections.required: Compute the relative suffix once and test/store that same key.

additional_admission_constraints: Set an explicit all-protocol transport denial such as GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL empty in addition to GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH; do not assume a silently ignored environment flag is a no-network boundary for installed Git2.43.

Root must use an isolated Python invocation (-I -B with an explicitly observed interpreter) to avoid ambient PYTHONPATH/site option injection and pycache creation; bind exact revised script SHA before launch.
All actions remain against the pinned committed handoff only. No current checkout/source-LF proof or broad archive reference closure follows.
No output extraction, packed-code import, old runner import/execution, stopped-scope procedure work, candidate mutation, signing or publication is permitted.
Root alone runs the first accepted verify; agents use bounded approved show only after root announces acceptance and initial outcome.
limitations: Source-only hypothetical counterexamples, not observed runtime incidents. The frozen supplied reader remains unchanged and its prior refusal remains. G7/G8 CLOSED; PVU007 STOP; PVU011 NO RETRY; PVA029 FAIL/no automatic retry.
